blocks.text: NEW YORK — Christina Applegate, who has candidly shared raw details about her journey with multiple sclerosis (MS) for years, revealed Monday her doctor says she doesn’t have the autoimmune disease and was misdiagnosed. “I’m back at square one where I don’t know what’s going on with me,” the actor said on the latest edition of her podcast “MeSsy,” along with co-host Jamie-Lynn Sigler, who has been public about her own battle with MS.
